name: Hot-cue drumming: sixteenth fills
lesson:
## Four on the floor with a sixteenth fill

Kick (A1) on every beat, snare (A2) on 2 and 4, and on beat 4 of each bar a four-hit sixteenth-note fill on the hat (A3). The fill is 121 ms between hits at this tempo.

Sixteenth fills on pads are played with two alternating fingers, not one finger four times; one finger cannot keep 121 ms even for four hits. The fill starts exactly on beat 4 and the last hit lands on the "a" of 4 so the next bar's kick is clean. Slow the tempo until the fill is even, then bring it back up.

tracks.cue: Kick, snare and hat from the intro; the sixteenth fill on the hat cue.
Kick, clap and hat from the intro at 125.
